cases.mechanism: Both the original grader (rfind of the literal "\\boxed{") and patch.py's _boxes() (find of the literal token "\\boxed") recognize only \boxed. A final answer typeset with the equivalent LaTeX box command \fbox{B} is invisible to both. The original parses 'C' from the earlier \boxed{C}, and tighten's _final_box also picks \boxed{C}, so _normalize gives 'C' == gold and the reward stays 1.0.
